description: Check the form of one US court-reporter citation: volume, reporter, first page, an optional pinpoint page, and the parenthetical with the court and year, for example '347 U.S. 483, 495 (1954)' or '500 F. Supp. 2d 1234 (S.D.N.Y. 2007)'. Send only the citation from the volume number on (no case name). Get back each part found, every form problem with the fix (reporter spelling and spacing, the pinpoint before the first page, a missing court or year, the year in parentheses), and warnings such as a year earlier than the reporter series began. It does not say the case exists: it checks the form only. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/citation-format-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.
